name: Days between dates
description: Days between two dates, or until/since a date.
solve: function solve(q,ctx){const t=q.replace(/(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)\b/g,'$1');const M='jan feb mar apr may jun jul aug sep oct nov dec'.split(' ');const now=new Date(ctx&&ctx.now||Date.now());const re=/\b(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2})(?:,?\s*(\d{4}))?|\b(\d{1,2})\s+(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*(?:,?\s*(\d{4}))?|\b(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b|\b(today|tomorrow|yesterday)\b/gi;const ds=[];let m;while(m=re.exec(t)){let d;if(m[1])d=new Date(m[3]?+m[3]:now.getFullYear(),M.indexOf(m[1].toLowerCase().slice(0,3)),+m[2]);else if(m[5])d=new Date(m[6]?+m[6]:now.getFullYear(),M.indexOf(m[5].toLowerCase().slice(0,3)),+m[4]);else if(m[7])d=new Date(+m[7],+m[8]-1,+m[9]);else{d=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate()+({today:0,tomorrow:1,yesterday:-1})[m[10].toLowerCase()])}ds.push({d,yearGiven:!!(m[3]||m[6]||m[7]||m[10])})}const today=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate());if(!ds.length)return{answer:null,reason:'No dates found.'};let a,b;if(ds.length>=2){a=ds[0].d;b=ds[1].d}else{a=today;b=ds[0].d;if(!ds[0].yearGiven&&/\b(until|till|to go|left)\b/i.test(t)&&b<today)b=new Date(b.getFullYear()+1,b.getMonth(),b.getDate())}const days=Math.round((Date.UTC(b.getFullYear(),b.getMonth(),b.getDate())-Date.UTC(a.getFullYear(),a.getMonth(),a.getDate()))/864e5);const fmt=d=>d.toDateString();const w=Math.floor(Math.abs(days)/7),r=Math.abs(days)%7;return{answer:`${Math.abs(days)} days${w?` (${w} week${w>1?'s':''}${r?` and ${r} day${r>1?'s':''}`:''})`:''}`,steps:[`From ${fmt(a)} to ${fmt(b)}`,`${days<0?'That date has passed: ':''}${Math.abs(days)} days`]}}
